personal_test.title: Personal test instance
personal_test.testnet: Shared demos with test coins are allowed on testnet.
personal_test.mainnet: Deploy and use your own allowlisted, capped private copy on mainnet.
personal_test.accounts: Add only other accounts you own; there is no public enrollment.
personal_test.local: Keep the frontend local. No uploads, public listing, or shared mainnet service.
personal_test.fees: No protocol fee. Your wallet still pays network execution, proving and state fees.
personal_test.caps: Caps use raw base units, not a dollar price or an oracle.
personal_test.identity: Verify personal-test, owner, caps and deployment authority before use.
personal_test.unavailable: This design has no executable contract yet; mainnet testing needs an implementation with the same personal policy.
